checks.type: ASCII URI schemes, escaped components, reg-name authorities, userinfo and decimal ports; no fetch or shared URL-parser cache

checks.cancellation: Both NCName and URI literal match checkpoints cancel before any target resolver is entered
checks.installed_base_smoke: Passed isolated installed wheel with Formats and Model only; Unicode Id and rejected Id/Type cases verified without optional document engines

limits: Linear regular expressions and literal component scans use the existing aggregate XML character/part/node budgets; cancellation before and after lexical validation
remaining: Full URI/IRI/IP-literal and XML Schema whitespace profiles, content-type field validation and independent larger corpus; reachability_complete is not a complete OPC conformance certificate
